mapper.sql: aess.system_setting_id as "systemSettingId", ee.element_id as "elementId", ei.item_id as "itemId", ea.area_id as "areaId", ea.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", ea.area_code as "areaCode", ea.area_name as "areaName", ei.item_code as "itemCode", ei.item_name as "itemName", ee.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ee.element_code as "elementCode", ee.element_name as "elementName", aess.target_scope as "targetScope", aess.active_yn as "activeYn", aess.change_reason as "changeReason", aess.updated_by as "updatedBy", aess.updated_at as "updatedAt"

from area_element_system_settings aess inner join evaluation_areas ea on ea.area_id = aess.area_id inner join evaluation_items ei on ei.item_id = aess.item_id inner join evaluation_elements ee on ee.element_id = aess.element_id inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ea.rule_version_id

where.if: and (aess.target_scope ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into area_element_system_settings (area_id, item_id, element_id, target_scope, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{areaId}, #{itemId}, #{elementId}, #{request.targetScope}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (area_id, item_id, element_id, target_scope) do update set active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
